piece_kind.instructions: Determine what this part of a support ticket does

criteria.greeting: Says hello or goodbye, with no request
criteria.feeling: Expresses an emotion about the situation
criteria.request: Asks for something new to be added or done

category.instructions: Determine the broad category of this support ticket

criteria.bug_report: The user is reporting something that is broken or producing errors
criteria.feature_request: The user is requesting new functionality

bug_severity.instructions: How severe is the reported issue
criteria: Broken or degraded feature; workaround exists

has_reproducible_steps.instructions: The user describes specific steps to reproduce the issue

refund_requested.instructions: The user is explicitly asking for a refund or credit

category_reordered.instructions: Determine the broad category of this support ticket

criteria.feature_request: The user is requesting new functionality
criteria.bug_report: The user is reporting something that is broken or producing errors

mentions_billing_issue.instructions: The user raises a problem with a charge, invoice, refund or subscription

mentions_account_issue.instructions: The user raises a problem with logging in, permissions, their profile or account security

mentions_bug.instructions: The user reports something that is broken or producing errors

mentions_feature_request.instructions: The user asks for or suggests new functionality

issue_count.instructions: How many separate problems or requests does the user raise

criteria.four_or_more: Four or more separate problems or requests

message_type.instructions: Determine what kind of message this is overall

criteria.question: Mainly asks for information
criteria.request: Mainly asks for something to be done
criteria.feedback: Mainly gives an opinion or a suggestion
criteria.problem_report: Mainly reports something that went wrong

primary_team.instructions: Which team should handle this ticket first

criteria.billing_and_payments: Charges, refunds, invoices and payment methods
criteria.product_management: Ideas and requests for new features

priority.instructions: How quickly should support act on this ticket
criteria: Low: it can wait a week or more
High: today, because money or account access is affected
Urgent: right now, because many users or safety are at risk

time_pressure.instructions: The user mentions a deadline or says the matter is urgent

needs_staff_action.instructions: Resolving this ticket needs a staff member to take an action, not just send an answer

needs_more_info.instructions: Support needs more details from the user before it can resolve every problem raised

journey_stage.instructions: Determine where the user is in their relationship with the company

criteria.checkout: Is in the middle of paying

duplicate_charge.instructions: The user says they were charged more than once for the same purchase

criteria.true: Asks for a refund outright, or describes a charge they should not have paid
criteria.false: Describes no charge they want reversed

charge_amount_given.instructions: The user states the amount they were charged

payment_method_used.instructions: Which payment method did the user pay with

criteria.not_stated: The message doesn't say how they paid

order_date_given.instructions: The user says when they placed the order

chargeback_mentioned.instructions: The user says they will dispute the charge with their bank or card company

cannot_log_in.instructions: The user cannot log in to their account

problem_after_update.instructions: The user says a problem started after a site or app update

blames_update.instructions: The user thinks a site update caused their problem

criteria.true: Says or strongly suggests that the update caused it
criteria.false: Mentions no update, or mentions one only to say when the problem started

error_message_given.instructions: The user quotes or describes a specific error message

device_or_browser_given.instructions: The user says which device, browser or app they use

tried_fix_themselves.instructions: The user says what they already tried to fix the problem

security_related.instructions: The ticket involves account security, such as access, passwords or suspicious activity

possible_widespread_issue.instructions: The problem the user describes could be affecting many users, not just this one

wants_new_payment_method.instructions: The user asks for or suggests a new way to pay

feature_request_strength.instructions: How strongly does the user ask for a new feature
criteria: Doesn't ask for any new feature
Mentions it in passing or as a nice-to-have
Demands it or makes it a condition of staying

sentiment.instructions: How positive or negative is the message overall

frustration_rising.instructions: The user says their frustration is growing

threatens_to_leave.instructions: The user threatens to cancel, leave or shop elsewhere

churn_risk.instructions: How likely is this user to stop being a customer

asks_for_human.instructions: The user asks to speak with a person, a manager or a supervisor

prior_contact.instructions: The user has contacted support about this before

criteria.true: Mentions an earlier attempt, ticket or message

existing_customer.instructions: The user has already bought something from this company

has_account.instructions: The user has an account with this company

identity_details_given.instructions: The user gives their name, email address or account username

likely_apple_user.instructions: The user probably owns Apple devices

sensitive_data_present.instructions: The message contains sensitive data, such as a full card number, a password or a home address

issues_related.instructions: The problems the user raises probably share one cause
